# AIM — AI Infrastructure & Machines
> AIM is a technology engineering agency: "Your Engineering Team, On Demand." From one senior engineer to a complete product team, AIM designs, builds, deploys and operates production-grade software, AI systems, automation and cloud infrastructure. Udyam-registered MSME based in Madhya Pradesh, India. Client Partner & Technical Lead: Ankit Panicker.

## Ways to work with AIM
1. Hire an Engineer — backend, frontend, full-stack, AI, cloud, DevOps, platform.
2. Hire a Specialist — AI architecture, voice AI, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, API architecture, automation, DevOps, system modernization, technical architecture.
3. Hire an Engineering Pod — flexible cross-functional team, e.g. technical lead, backend, frontend, AI/platform engineer, QA.
4. Hire a Complete Product Team — product strategy, UX/UI, architecture, frontend, backend, AI, infrastructure, DevOps, QA, deployment, operations.
Pricing: dedicated engineer and pods are custom engagements; product development is a scoped proposal; AI/infrastructure work is architecture-based.

## Production experience
15K+ production calls processed, 6.8K+ answered (~45% connected/answered) on APEX Connect for Apple Hospital (AI-powered patient communication); a dedicated multi-tenant communication environment for BIMTS College; a digital experience for Café Ciel at The OWO, London, delivered on schedule. Three industry verticals served: healthcare, education, hospitality.

## Platforms
- APEX Connect — AI-powered customer engagement infrastructure: multi-tenant platform for voice, messaging and AI workflows. Usage-based pricing varies by call duration, communication provider and AI processing requirements. https://aimstudio.co.in/app
- AIM Remote AI — AI operating layer for your machines (Windows, Android, Chrome). https://aimstudio.co.in/remoteai
- Healthcare Operations Platform — in development.
